_readme: One row per product. refresh_prices.py updates price/was/checked/url for source=shopify rows. Manual rows (source=manual) are checked by hand once a month. Never invent a price: leave price null and the page shows a link instead.

items.name: UnifyDrive UC250
items.note: The cheap 2-bay with a real Intel chip. Plex-capable. Drives not included.

items.name: UnifyDrive UT2 (portable)
items.note: A NAS with a battery built in. For photo shoots and travel, not a media library.

items.name: UnifyDrive UC450 Pro
items.note: Serious box. Overkill for most homes, right for a big library.

items.name: Beelink ME mini (6 SSD slots)
items.note: A tiny, silent all-SSD NAS. US stock was not confirmed, so check the page.

items.name: GMKtec NucBox KB2 Max (barebone)
items.note: Cheapest real Intel box here. Bring your own RAM and SSD.

items.name: GMKtec NucBox G3 Ultra
items.note: Ready to go. Fine for Home Assistant, Pi-hole and light Plex.

items.name: GMKtec NucBox M3 Pro (barebone)
items.note: A lot of CPU for the money if you have spare RAM.

items.name: GMKtec M3S
items.note: Newer Intel chip. Check the RAM is enough for your VMs.

items.name: GMKtec M10
items.note: The Proxmox pick. More cores and RAM for several VMs.

items.name: Beelink EQi
items.note: Same chip as the GMKtec M3S with more RAM and storage.

items.name: Beelink EQi Pro
items.note: Two 2.5GbE ports. A good router or firewall box too.

items.name: WD Red Plus 4TB (WD40EFPX)
items.note: Small, quiet, cheap per drive. Bad price per TB.

items.name: WD Red Plus 8TB (WD80EFPX)
items.note: The usual sweet spot for a 2-bay mirror.

items.name: WD Red Plus 12TB (WD120EFBX)
items.note: Biggest Red Plus. Louder than the small ones.

items.name: WD Red Pro 16TB
items.note: Where price per TB usually starts to drop.
items.amazon: WD Red Pro 16TB NAS hard drive

items.name: WD Red Pro 20TB
items.note: Fewer bays needed for the same space.
items.amazon: WD Red Pro 20TB NAS hard drive

items.name: WD Red Pro 24TB
items.note: Only if a drive failure and a long rebuild don't scare you.
items.amazon: WD Red Pro 24TB NAS hard drive

items.name: pCloud Premium 500GB, lifetime
items.note: Pay once. Small. Good for documents and photos, not a NAS.

items.name: pCloud Premium Plus 2TB, lifetime
items.note: Pays for itself in about five years against $99 a year.

items.name: pCloud Ultra 10TB, lifetime
items.note: Lowest price per TB here if you keep it long enough.

items.name: Backblaze Personal Backup
items.note: Unlimited backup of one computer. Not for a NAS.

items.name: Anker 332 USB-C Hub (5-in-1)
items.note: The safe default: HDMI, one USB-C and two USB-A data ports, plus charging passthrough.

items.name: UGREEN Revodok 5-in-1 USB-C Hub
items.note: Same five-port layout as the Anker, with 100W passthrough. Buy whichever is cheaper today.

items.name: UGREEN 6-in-1 USB-C Hub with SD reader
items.note: Adds SD and microSD slots and runs HDMI at 4K 60Hz. No charging passthrough.

items.name: UGREEN Revodok 7-in-1 USB-C Hub with Ethernet
items.note: Gigabit Ethernet port. The pick for a laptop that lives on a desk.

items.name: Anker 4-Port USB 3.0 Hub
items.note: USB-A in, four USB-A out, data only. Four more ports for a box that ran out.

items.name: Sabrent EC-SNVE M.2 NVMe/SATA enclosure
items.note: Takes NVMe or SATA M.2 drives, 10Gbps, no screwdriver.

items.name: UGREEN M.2 NVMe and SATA enclosure
items.note: UGREEN's version of the same idea: NVMe or SATA, 10Gbps, tool-free.

items.name: dockteck M.2 NVMe/SATA enclosure
items.note: Lesser-known brand, same spec sheet: NVMe or SATA, 10Gbps, UASP.

items.name: ORICO aluminum M.2 NVMe enclosure (PWM2)
items.note: Aluminum shell, NVMe only. Turns a spare SSD into a fast pocket drive.

items.name: UGREEN tool-free M.2 NVMe enclosure
items.note: NVMe only, tool-free, and listed as working on Thunderbolt ports too.

items.name: Sabrent EC-UASP 2.5-inch SATA enclosure
items.note: For the 2.5-inch SSD or laptop drive pulled out of an old machine.

items.name: TP-Link TL-SG105 5-port gigabit switch
items.note: Five gigabit ports in a metal box, no fan. Plug it in and forget it exists.

items.name: TP-Link TL-SG105E 5-port Easy Smart switch
items.note: Same box with a web page: VLANs, QoS and port mirroring for tinkering.

items.name: TP-Link TL-SG108 8-port gigabit switch
items.note: Eight ports, for when the mini PC, NAS and TV all want a cable.

items.name: NETGEAR GS305 5-port gigabit switch
items.note: The other safe five-port. Pick on price.

items.name: Cable Matters Cat6 cables, 5-pack, 5 ft
items.note: Five snagless 5-foot Cat6 cables. Enough for a switch, a NAS and a mini PC.

items.name: Amazon Basics Cat6 cables, 5-pack, 5 ft, multicolor
items.note: Color-coded, so the NAS cable and the router cable stop looking the same.

items.name: Kasa KP115 smart plug with energy monitoring
items.note: Shows what your server draws, in watts, in an app. Home Assistant can read it.

items.name: Kasa KP125M Matter smart plug, 2-pack
items.note: Energy monitoring plus Matter, so Apple Home, Google and Alexa all see it.

items.name: P3 Kill A Watt P4400 usage monitor
items.note: No Wi-Fi and no account. Plug in, read the watts on the screen.

items.name: Amazon Smart Plug
items.note: Alexa-only on and off. No energy readings, so fine for a lamp, not a server audit.

items.name: Anker USB-C power strip, 6 outlets, 20W
items.note: Six outlets plus USB-C charging in a small block. Only 300 joules, so the NAS goes on a UPS.

items.name: Anker 331 power strip, 6 outlets, 3 USB
items.note: Six outlets, three USB ports and a flat plug that fits behind a desk.

items.name: VELCRO Brand ONE-WRAP ties, 50-pack
items.note: Fifty reusable ties. Undo them when the setup changes, which it will.

items.name: JOTO cable management sleeve, 4-pack
items.note: Zips a bundle of desk cables into one tube.

items.name: ENVISIONED adhesive cable clips, 10-pack
items.note: Sticky clips that stop chargers sliding off the desk. Ties included.

items.name: Sleclean under-desk cable tray with clamp
items.note: Clamp-on steel tray. The power strip and the mess go under the desk, no drilling.

items.name: Delamu cord hider raceway kit, 157 in
items.note: Adhesive channels that hide cords running down a wall to the outlet.

items.name: Anker Nano 30W USB-C GaN Charger (511 Nano 3)
items.note: Folding plug, one USB-C port, 30W PD. Small enough to live in a laptop bag.

items.name: UGREEN Nexode 45W 2-Port GaN Charger
items.note: Two USB-C ports. 45W from one port, split when both are busy. Charges a MacBook Air at full speed.

items.name: Anker USB-C to USB-C Cable 240W, 6 ft (2-pack)
items.note: Two 6 ft cables rated for 240W, so one cable covers phone, laptop and mini PC.

items.name: Anker Zolo USB-C Cable 240W Braided, 6 ft
items.note: Braided jacket that survives being stepped on and stuffed in a bag.

items.name: Anker Bio-Braided USB-C Cable 240W, 6 ft (2-pack)
items.note: Braided 240W pair. Buy once, stop hunting for the one good cable.

items.name: AVLT VESA Mount for Mini PCs and Thin Clients (up to 2.76 in thick)

cols.Best for: Hiding the box behind a monitor

items.note: Adjustable cradle that holds most mini PCs on a monitor back, arm, pole or under a desk.

items.name: VIVO Steel VESA Bracket for Intel NUC
items.note: Steel bracket on the 75/100 mm VESA holes. Simple, solid, cheap.

items.name: Deal4GO Mini PC VESA Wall Mount Bracket
items.note: Replacement-style NUC plate that screws to the monitor or wall and lets the PC slide off.

items.name: AC Infinity MULTIFAN S3 120mm USB Fan
items.note: USB-powered 120mm fan with a speed dial. Lay it beside a mini PC or router running hot in a closet.

items.name: havit HV-F2056 Cooling Pad (3 fans)

cols.Best for: Mini PC or laptop that throttles

items.note: Metal mesh top, three fans, USB powered. Set the mini PC on it and it runs cooler and quieter.

items.name: Coolertek N2 Cooling Pad (2 big fans)
items.note: Two large slow fans move air with less whine than many small ones.

items.name: SanDisk High Endurance microSDXC 64GB
items.note: Made for dash cams that write all day, which is close to what a Pi's database does.

items.name: SanDisk MAX Endurance microSDXC 64GB
items.note: The longest-rated SanDisk endurance card. Pick it when you never want to reflash.

items.name: Samsung PRO Endurance microSDXC 64GB
items.note: Samsung's endurance card for cameras that record nonstop, with a long warranty.

items.name: Samsung EVO Select microSDXC 128GB
items.note: A2-rated for quick small reads. Fine for a Pi that mostly reads; less endurance than the cards above.

items.name: Samsung FIT Plus USB 3.1 Flash Drive 128GB
items.note: Tiny stick that stays plugged in. Fast enough to boot TrueNAS, Unraid or a Proxmox installer.

items.name: SanDisk Ultra Fit USB 3.2 Flash Drive 128GB
items.note: Low-profile stick that sits flush in the back of a mini PC.

items.name: Cable Matters Snagless Cat6 Patch Cable, 3 ft (5-pack)
items.note: Five short snagless cables. Enough to tidy a switch in one go.

items.name: Cable Matters Shielded Cat6a Patch Cable, 1 ft (5-pack)
items.note: Shielded Cat6a, rated 10Gbps. One-foot runs from patch panel to switch.

items.name: Amazon Basics Cat6 Ethernet Cable, 25 ft
items.note: One long cable to get the server off Wi-Fi.

items.name: VCELINK Cat6 Keystone Jacks, 10-pack
items.note: UL-listed punch-down jacks with a slim profile. Ten for the price of two at a hardware store.

items.name: RJ45 / RJ11 Network Cable Tester
items.note: Lights up each wire pair so you know which end you botched.

items.name: Amazon Basics 6-Outlet Surge Protector, 790 J, 6 ft
items.note: Six outlets, circuit breaker, protection light. Boring in the best way.

items.name: Belkin 6-Outlet Pivot-Plug Surge Protector, 1,080 J
items.note: Rotating outlets so wall-wart adapters stop blocking each other.

items.name: Belkin 6-Outlet Wall-Mount Surge Protector with USB
items.note: Plugs straight into the wall: six outlets and two USB ports with no cable to trip on.

items.name: Anker Surge Protector Power Strip
items.note: Surge strip with USB charging ports built in. Check the listing for the outlet count.

items.name: Poniie PN1500 Watt Meter
items.note: Plug-through meter that shows watts, volts and kWh. Small enough to leave on one device for a week.

items.name: P3 Kill A Watt P4400 Electricity Usage Monitor
items.note: The meter everyone recommends. Measure what your server costs per month before you buy a bigger one.

items.name: FUERAN 4K HDMI Dummy Plug Headless Display Emulator
items.note: Tricks a headless mini PC or Mac Mini into unlocking full 4K remote desktop resolution without a monitor.

items.name: EVanlak 4K@60Hz HDMI Dummy Plug EDID Emulator
items.note: Aluminum 4K 60Hz EDID emulator. Keeps hardware video acceleration active when no screen is attached.

items.name: Anker 310 USB-C to HDMI Adapter (4K@60Hz)
items.note: Simple aluminum USB-C to HDMI dongle for setting up a BIOS or connecting a laptop to any TV.

items.name: Cable Matters USB-C to DisplayPort 1.4 Adapter
items.note: Compact USB-C to DisplayPort 1.4 adapter for high-refresh or 4K monitors when HDMI ports are full.

items.name: Amazon Basics Braided High-Speed HDMI Cable, 3 ft
items.note: Three-foot braided 4K 60Hz HDMI cable. Just long enough for a mini PC mounted behind the screen.

items.name: Plugable USBC-E2500 2.5GbE USB-C and USB-A Adapter
items.note: Realtek RTL8156B chipset with an attached USB-A tip. Reliable Linux, Proxmox, Windows and macOS support.

items.name: UGREEN USB-C to 2.5GbE Aluminum Ethernet Adapter
items.note: Compact aluminum shell that bumps a 1GbE laptop or mini PC up to 2.5Gbps for fast NAS transfers.

items.name: Anker PowerExpand USB-C to 2.5Gbps Ethernet Adapter
items.note: Braided cord and aluminum body from Anker. Plug-and-play 2.5GbE on modern laptops and mini PCs.

items.name: Cable Matters USB-C to 2.5GbE Braided Adapter
items.note: Aluminum heatsink body with braided pigtail built to handle long multi-gigabit backups without throttling.

items.name: TP-Link UE300C USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet Adapter
items.note: Standard 1GbE, not 2.5GbE, but tiny, foldable and cheap when you only need a spare wired port.

items.name: ARCTIC MX-6 Thermal Paste (4g)
items.note: Non-conductive, thick enough to resist pump-out on bare mini PC laptop dies. Four grams lasts several builds.

items.name: Noctua NT-H1 Thermal Compound
items.note: No cure time, non-conductive, easy to clean up. A safe staple for desktops and homelab boxes.

items.name: Sabrent M.2 2280 SSD Rocket Heatsink (SB-HTSK)
items.note: Copper and aluminum heatsink with thermal tape included. Check height clearance before using inside a mini PC.

items.name: Thermalright M.2 2280 NVMe SSD Heatsink
items.note: Low-cost aluminum cooler with silicone pads to keep a Proxmox or NAS cache SSD from thermal throttling.

items.name: iFixit Moray 32-Bit Precision Driver Kit

cols.Best for: Opening mini PCs and NAS boxes

items.note: Magnetic case with Phillips, Torx and hex bits that won't strip tiny M.2 standoff screws.

items.name: SONOFF Zigbee 3.0 USB Dongle Plus (ZBDongle-P, CC2652P)
items.note: The gold-standard TI CC2652P coordinator with an external antenna. Rock solid on Zigbee2MQTT and ZHA.

items.name: SONOFF Zigbee 3.0 USB Dongle Plus-E (EFR32MG21)
items.note: Silicon Labs EFR32MG21 chip in an aluminum shell. Plug-and-play with Home Assistant ZHA.

items.name: TP-Link UB500 Bluetooth 5.0 Nano USB Adapter
items.note: Adds Linux-supported Bluetooth to a mini PC or Pi for tracking temperature sensors and SwitchBot gear.

items.name: Amazon Basics USB 2.0 Extension Cable (6.5 ft)
items.note: Mandatory cheap fix: moves a Zigbee stick away from noisy USB 3.0 ports so sensors stop dropping offline.

items.name: UGREEN USB Extension Cable (6 ft)

cols.Best for: Placing dongles out in the open

items.note: Plug into a USB 2.0 port to lift a Zigbee or Bluetooth stick out of a metal cabinet or behind a rack.

items.name: Sabrent USB 3.0 to 2.5-Inch SATA Hard Drive Adapter (EC-SSHD)
items.note: Plug any bare 2.5-inch SATA SSD or laptop drive straight into USB without screwing it into a case.

items.name: StarTech USB 3.0 to 2.5-Inch SATA Adapter Cable (USB3S2SAT3CB)
items.note: UASP-capable SATA adapter with StarTech reliability. Great for imaging Linux drives and wiping old SSDs.

items.name: Anker USB-C 2-in-1 SD and microSD Card Reader
items.note: Compact USB-C reader with full SD and microSD slots. Fast for flashing Home Assistant or unloading cameras.

items.name: UGREEN USB-C Dual SD and microSD Card Reader
items.note: Reads SD and microSD simultaneously over 5Gbps USB-C. Works on laptops, tablets and phones.

items.name: SanDisk MobileMate USB 3.0 microSD Card Reader
items.note: Thumb-sized USB-A reader built for fast UHS-I microSD writes. Keep one in the homelab drawer.

_awin._readme: Fill affid with the publisher ID from Awin once approved. Set approved true per brand only after Awin approves that brand. Until then pages link to the store with no tracking.

_amazon._readme: Amazon Associates tag. Items with an 'amazon' search phrase get an extra 'Check Amazon' link. No Amazon prices are shown (Amazon rules). Rows with source 'amazon' and an 'asin' link straight to that Amazon product page with the tag and the utm fields here. Never add a price to them. A row may add its own 'utm' object to override fields for that row (Wave 2 rows use utm_campaign exp001_w2).
